test_chrono_system_clock: test the pybind11 chrono module by calling test_chrono1 to get current system clock as a datetime
test_chrono_system_clock_roundtrip: test roundtripping a datetime through pybind11 chrono test_chrono2 and verify no information is lost
test_chrono_duration_roundtrip: test roundtripping a timedelta through pybind11 chrono test_chrono3 and verify days seconds and microseconds match
test_chrono_steady_clock: test the pybind11 chrono steady clock by calling test_chrono5 and verify it returns a timedelta
test_floating_point_duration: test converting a floating point seconds value to timedelta via test_chrono7 and verify precision
